Chrisean Rock, born Chrisean Eugenia Malone, is an American rapper, reality television personality, and social media influencer from Baltimore, Maryland. She initially gained recognition through her athletic background before entering the entertainment industry and developing a massive social media following.

She rose to mainstream fame through her appearances on Baddies and Blueface & Chrisean: Crazy in Love, where her highly publicized relationship with Blueface became a major topic across social media.

Outside of reality television, Chrisean has pursued a music career, releasing songs such as “Vibe” and “Lonely.” She welcomed her son, Chrisean Jesus Malone Jr., in September 2023.

Chrisean continues to attract attention through her livestreams, music releases, television appearances, and viral social media moments, making her a widely recognized personality in hip-hop entertainment. Wikipedia

#Blueface, born Johnathan Michael Porter, is a Los Angeles rapper, entertainer, and internet personality known for his unconventional offbeat flow, distinctive West Coast sound, and viral personality.

Before pursuing music, Blueface was a standout quarterback at Arleta High School and briefly played college football at Fayetteville State University.

He broke into the mainstream in 2018 before achieving international success with his hit single “Thotiana,” which peaked at No. 8 on the Billboard Hot 100 and received remixes featuring Cardi B and YG. He was also named a member of the 2019 XXL Freshman Class.

Throughout his career, Blueface has collaborated with major artists, including DDG, Lil Baby, French Montana, G-Eazy, and Rich The Kid, while releasing popular records such as “Bleed It,” “Daddy,” and “Moonwalking in Calabasas” with DDG.

Beyond music, Blueface has become a prominent figure in reality television, livestreaming, and hip-hop culture, frequently generating headlines surrounding his personal life, family, and relationship with Chrisean Rock. XXL Mag +2
